questions.why: Complementary colours sit opposite each other on the wheel: blue and orange.

questions.q: Which paint is transparent and uses the white of the paper for highlights?
questions.why: Watercolour is transparent, so highlights are left as paper or lifted out.
Tint = hue + white; shade = hue + black.

questions.q: Describe how to mix a dark without using black.
questions.model: Mix two complementary colours, such as blue and orange, to make a deep brown-grey and adjust the balance; it is richer than black.
